cards.name: Scent of Ivy
cards.oracleText: Reveal any number of green cards in your hand. Target creature gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of cards revealed this way.

cards.name: Scent of Brine
cards.oracleText: Reveal any number of blue cards in your hand. Counter target spell unless its controller pays {1} for each card revealed this way.

cards.name: Scent of Jasmine
cards.oracleText: Reveal any number of white cards in your hand. You gain 2 life for each card revealed this way.

cards.name: Scent of Nightshade
cards.oracleText: Reveal any number of black cards in your hand. Target creature gets -X/-X until end of turn, where X is the number of cards revealed this way.

cards.name: Scent of Cinder
cards.oracleText: Reveal any number of red cards in your hand. Scent of Cinder deals X damage to any target, where X is the number of cards revealed this way.
